calibration_curve_points.csv.description: Smooth risk curves and pointwise patient-cluster intervals for raw predictions and the fixed 500-label Platt repeat-0 fit.

calibration_risk_bins.csv.description: Empirical score-bin support, event counts, mean predictions and observed event fractions underlying the smooth curves.

calibration_risk_summary.csv.description: Risk distribution, mean predicted and observed risks, Brier/logloss, curve status and fixed-fit provenance per model/cohort.

global_50_500_summary.csv.description: Complete 200-draw results at 50 and 500 labels, both proper scores, adaptation event P05/P95 and failed-fit/fallback counts.

global_recalibration_repeat_scores.csv.description: All 200 repeat-level raw, prevalence, Jeffreys, intercept and Platt results for each available budget; Brier/logloss and patient-weighted sensitivity.

hgbt_supplementary_calibration_v4.csv.description: Verified v4 pooled eICU/NWICU HGBT calibration summaries across 200 adaptation draws; offset is displayed as intercept and preserved in source_archive_method. Historical aggregate only, not recomputed on repaired-v5 scores or site-level.

paired_loss_gap_bootstrap.csv.description: Raw gap, Platt gap, and post-gap minus raw-gap for Brier/logloss using saved per-stay means across all 200 fits; 1000 paired patient-cluster bootstraps and patient-weighted sensitivity.

per_stay_repeat_mean_parity.csv.description: Parity checks that saved fit parameters recreate each server-only per-stay mean-loss array across 200 fits.
